title: Root-normalization stalk comparison with a DVR model
statement: Take schemes L,U and i:U->L, a finite G-torsor W->U [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], Spec R->L and a chart beta:U times_L Spec R isomorphic to D(f), compatible with projection. Let H be Noetherian, b:R->H, g=b(f) a nonzerodivisor, H/(g) a nonzero domain, and n=|G| a unit in H. Set A=H[t]/(t^n-g), N=Spec A, V=D(g), p the indicated pullback cover over V, and a=p followed by V->N. Assume N locally Noetherian, p finite etale, and a.fromNormalization finite. For a point x of a.normalization lying over the prime (t), there exist a DVR B with uniformizer pi, n invertible in B, a G-torsor T over Spec Frac(B), and a point x0 of the finite relative normalization of pullback.snd(T.pi followed by Spec Frac(B)->Spec B, Spec B[s]/(s^n-pi)->Spec B) over (s). There is a ring equivalence from this model stalk to the original stalk which carries the structural germ of s to the structural germ of t. The actual model in the proof is B=H_(g), pi=g, and T the pullback of W along the chart to Spec Frac(B). No regularity or maximal-ideal conclusion about the normalization stalk is asserted. Relative normalization is [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization].

source.place: Tag 0307 (lemma-integral-closure-localize); affine normalization description and stalk base change

proof.text: The quotient-domain assumption makes (g) prime. Take the actual ring B=Localization.AtPrime (g). Apply lem-sbc-regular-principal-prime-localization-dvr to obtain its domain and DVR structures and irreducibility of the actual image pi of g. Map the unit |G| to B.

The image of g in Frac(B) is nonzero, since pi is irreducible and the fraction-ring map is injective. Thus the morphism r:Spec Frac(B)->Spec R has image in D(f). Lift through its open immersion, compose beta.inv and the first pullback projection to obtain k:Spec Frac(B)->U. The chart compatibility and the pullback condition prove k;i=r;phi. Transport the defining pullback square along beta, then paste it with IsOpenImmersion.isPullback_lift_id for r to obtain hbranch: the entire pullback of U along r;phi is Spec Frac(B). Apply GaloisCover.exists_baseChange to obtain T and its cartesian square with W.

Prove that the root ideal contracts to (g): evaluation at zero gives a map A->H/(g), killing t, which proves one inclusion; the relation t^n=g with n positive proves the other. Prove coefficient localization of the root quotient directly using Polynomial.isLocalization and IsLocalization.of_surjective; the quotient-kernel ideals are the corresponding principal polynomial ideals. Apply lem-sbc-root-normalization-localization-comparison with this localization certificate, the contraction equality, the actual B and pi, the proved hbranch, and the supplied T and cartesian square. Its qcqs witnesses, finite normalization and root-compatible stalk equivalence give the remaining existential conclusions.

lean.statement:
theorem root_normalization_dvr_comparison
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (b : R ⟶ H)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : H)) (hg : IsSMulRegular H (b.hom f))
    [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})] :
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    let := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    let := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      (a.fromNormalization x).asIdeal = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)} →
      let C := a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x
      let t := AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.toStalk A (a.fromNormalization x)
        (AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g))
      ∃ (B : CommRingCat.{u}) (hB : IsDomain B),
        letI := hB
        ∃ (hDvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing B),
          letI := hDvr
          ∃ (pi : B), Irreducible pi ∧ IsUnit (Nat.card G : B) ∧
          ∃ (T : GaloisCover G (Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B)))),
            let A0 := AdjoinRoot
              ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)
            let N0 := Spec (CommRingCat.of A0)
            let q0 := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A0))
            let j0 := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B)))
            let a0 := pullback.snd (T.π ≫ j0) q0
            ∃ (hqc : QuasiCompact a0) (hqs : QuasiSeparated a0),
              letI := hqc
              letI := hqs
              IsFinite a0.fromNormalization ∧
              ∃ (x0 : a0.normalization),
                (a0.fromNormalization x0).asIdeal = Ideal.span
                  {AdjoinRoot.root
                    ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)} ∧
                ∃ (e : a0.normalization.presheaf.stalk x0 ≃+* C),
                  e ((a0.fromNormalization.stalkMap x0).hom
                    (AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.toStalk A0 (a0.fromNormalization x0)
                      (AdjoinRoot.root
                        ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)))) =
                    (a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom t
